claim_boundary: These deterministically selected examples illustrate registered mechanisms and failures; they are not an estimator, a checkpoint-selection surface, or evidence beyond the bound records.
protocol_guards: No model forward, training, checkpoint selection, Gap tuning, or threshold fitting is performed.
Every predicate is required independently for seeds 17, 42, and 73.
Candidates are ranked by the declared numeric key and lexical identity; no visual judgment enters selection.
FineCops fixed thresholds come verbatim from sealed D3 calibration.
Test5 prediction coordinates are absent from sealed records and are not reconstructed.

selection.display_note: GT only: sealed Test5 records bind IoU but do not contain prediction coordinates.
selection.label: Base wrong, ARROW correct
selection.predicate: B58 top-1 IoU < 0.5 and ARROW top-1 IoU >= 0.5 for each seed 17/42/73.
selection.selection_order: maximum mean(ARROW IoU - B58 IoU), then lexical sample_id

selection.display_note: Raw R100 and deployed ARROW-V boxes shown for seed 42; predicate holds for all seeds.
selection.expression: Accompanied by the white and fancy umbrella, the walking woman is seen carrying a paper and adorned with a beaded and long necklace.
selection.label: Admission rescue
selection.predicate: Covered positive with raw-R100 IoU < 0.5 and deployed ARROW-V IoU >= 0.5 for every seed.
selection.selection_order: minimum mean eligible-query count, maximum mean IoU recovery, then lexical sample_id

selection.display_note: Class GT boxes and the two visual supports are shown; no predicted box is reconstructed.
selection.label: V switch succeeds, T fails
selection.predicate: Both visual-support arms switch correctly for every seed; the canonical-text pair fails in every seed; all oracle query sets exist.
selection.selection_order: maximum minimum V active-minus-counterfactual margin over two arms and three seeds, then lexical pair_id

selection.display_note: Class GT boxes visualize the controlled category pair; N is invariant to category input by construction.
selection.label: T switch succeeds, N fails
selection.predicate: Both canonical-text arms switch correctly for every seed; the category-agnostic null pair fails in every seed; all oracle query sets exist.
selection.selection_order: maximum minimum T active-minus-counterfactual margin over two arms and three seeds, then lexical pair_id

selection.display_note: Negative record boxes shown for seed 42; paired score inequalities hold for all seeds.
selection.expression: The carpet consists of the same material as the bench.
selection.label: External TN down-rank
selection.predicate: For each seed, B58 ranks the negative at least as high as its paired positive, while D3 ranks it lower and its score is below the sealed D3 threshold.
selection.selection_order: maximum mean paired ordering improvement across B58 and D3, then lexical negative sample_id

selection.display_note: A domain-shift failure: localization is correct but the fixed source-domain operating point rejects it.
selection.label: Fixed-tau false rejection
selection.predicate: Covered positive is localized at IoU >= 0.5 but D3 raw confidence is below that seed's sealed D3 calibration threshold for every seed.
selection.selection_order: minimum mean confidence/tau ratio, maximum mean deployed IoU, then lexical sample_id

selection.display_note: ARROW failure: the compositional text negative is falsely accepted for all seeds.
selection.expression: An old, dusty brown elephant is present nearby the silver automobile and facing the hills.
selection.label: Hard compositional false positive
selection.predicate: Covered FineCops text negative at level >= 2 has D3 raw confidence at or above the sealed threshold for every seed.
selection.selection_order: maximum negative level, maximum mean confidence/tau ratio, then lexical sample_id

selection.display_note: A useful R100 winner is removed by Admission for every seed.
selection.label: ARROW failure: Admission drop
selection.predicate: Covered positive has raw-R100 IoU >= 0.5 but deployed ARROW-V IoU < 0.5 for every seed.
selection.selection_order: maximum mean raw-R100-to-ARROW IoU drop, then lexical sample_id

selection.display_note: GT only: sealed Test5 records bind IoU but do not contain prediction coordinates.
selection.label: ARROW failure: within-eligible rank
selection.predicate: For every seed, an eligible query reaches IoU >= 0.5 but ARROW's selected top-1 has IoU < 0.5.
selection.selection_order: maximum mean(eligible-best IoU - top-1 IoU), then lexical sample_id

selection_scope.test5: sealed B58 and leakage-clean ARROW records
